intent: A field of grey points rolling toward the viewer in long swells, like contour lines of the sea: one monochrome 3D object on black whose only colour appears where the visitor touches the water.

stack.3d: three (plain Three.js, one Points mesh, custom ShaderMaterial with 2D simplex noise)
stack.motion: motion/react for the demo caption (variants, motion values for count-ups)

layout.component: fills its parent (absolute inset-0 in a sized box)
layout.field: a grid 18 units wide and 14 deep, dense along x and spaced along z so it reads as contour lines: 380×80 points on desktop, 200×96 under 640px
layout.camera: PerspectiveCamera at (0, 1.45, 5.2); landscape fov 42 looking at (0, −0.4, −3), portrait fov 58 looking at (0, −1.1, −3), so the horizon sits in the upper third
layout.demo: black 760px stage with @container; a buoy readout bottom-left over a 224px black-to-transparent gradient (eyebrow + three readings), hint bottom-right, stacked under 672px; no headline or buttons

typography.readingValue: display (Geist) 500, clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1.4cqi, 2.25rem), tracking −0.04em, tabular numerals; unit at 0.55em white/45 (° sits tight at full size)

color.crest: #ffffff, blended in as height rises from 0.04 to 0.42
color.accent: prop, default #ff7a45: mixed in only by the pointer mound and the dropped ring
color.blending: additive, depthWrite off, so dense crests bloom naturally
color.fade: fog between depth 5 and 16, a near-camera fade, a 45%→100% spotlight down the centre, soft left/right edges

motion.waves: two sine swells, a broad simplex noise drifting toward the viewer and a fine chop; speed multiplier prop
motion.pointer: ray-cast onto the y=0 plane; a Gaussian mound (0.38) follows with 0.08 lerp per 60 fps frame, scaled by dt; strength eases in and out
motion.ripple: pointerdown drops a ring that travels outward at 3.2 units/s and decays over about 3s
motion.reveal: uReveal 0→1 over 1.6s wall clock from first visibility; per row local = clamp(uReveal·1.6 − row·0.6), height × (1 − (1 − local)³), alpha × smoothstep(0, 0.4, local); the travelling front gets +35% white
motion.caption: eyebrow, readings and hint rise 12px from blur(8px) over 600ms, from 350ms, 60ms apart; figures count from 0 over 900ms with a 4px blur clearing
motion.reducedMotion: single still frame with the reveal complete, no pointer response; caption fades in ≤150ms, numbers set instantly

responsive.density: fewer points under 640px, and the field starts 1.5 units further back
responsive.lens: wider fov and a steeper look-down on portrait boxes
responsive.performance: DPR capped at 2; one draw call; the rAF loop only runs while visible and the tab is shown

accessibility: canvas is aria-hidden; the readout carries the meaning in text
touch-action pan-y so the field never traps page scroll
hint copy switches for touch devices
the readout sits over a gradient so contrast never depends on the animation

content.hint: Move to lift the swell · click to drop a stone

avoid: coloured points at rest, tinted washes or a glow blob behind the horizon
a hero headline or buttons inside the component
a CSS opacity fade in place of the shader reveal
